$comment: Shared behavioural contract for the browse card summary. client/src/utils/cardSummary.ts renders the card; server/src/utils/browseCardSummary.ts mirrors it so corpus:snapshot can count cards a student sees cut mid-sentence. Both suites read THIS file. Add a case here rather than to only one suite.
